name: Kajabi
tagline: Kajabi bundles a website, course builder, email marketing, and payments into one platform, with an AI assistant that drafts sales pages, emails, and course outlines from a short prompt. Life coaches and online educators use it to run a coaching business without stitching together separate tools for hosting, selling, and emailing clients.
